title: Fanim Industries Recalls Harbor Breeze Santa Ana Ceiling Fan Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores
summary: The fan's blade holders can break allowing the blade to be ejected from the fan, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 70,000.

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Gas-Powered Golf, PTV, Utility and Shuttle Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The starter generator wire can be improperly secured, allowing it to come into contact with the vehicle's exhaust, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 20,573.

title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The front wheel hubs on the golf cars can crack causing the front wheels to detach, posing a crash hazard that could result in injury or death to the user or bystander. Units: About 1,350.

title: Country Home Products Recalls DR Walk Behind Leaf Blowers Due to Projectile Hazard
summary: The blades inside the leaf blower can break off and discharge from the unit, posing a projectile hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 100.

title: Infantino Recalls Infant Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The buckles on the infant carriers can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 14,000.

title: Juratoys Recalls Bead Maze Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden triangle shape piece fails to meet the mandatory federal standard for small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 980.

title: Rawlings Recalls Catcher's Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The back plate of the catcher's helmet can fail to protect the player, posing a risk of head injury to the user. Units: About 1,400 (in addition, about 70 were sold in Canada).

title: Rooms To Go Recalls Patmos Chaise Lounge Chairs Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Ban (Recall Alert)
summary: The paint used on the chair's metal frame contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint standard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 385.

title: Star Water Systems Recalls Sump Pumps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The sump pumps can overheat, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 33,000.

title: Sun Organic Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate, which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 16,00

title: Just Blanks Children's Nightgowns Recalled by Ishtex Textile Products Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Burn Hazard
summary: The nightgowns fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 450.

title: Lennox Industries Recalls Ductless Heat Pumps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Internal electrical components can fail, allowing the units to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,650 (in addition, about 380 were sold in Canada).

title: Step2 Recalls Children's Grocery Shopping Carts Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The shopping cart's basket can break into sharp pieces, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 17,000 (In addition, about 3,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Whalen Recalls Bayside Furnishings 9-Piece Dining Sets Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The dining chairs can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 8,560.

title: Home Depot Recalls 4-Drawer Whitewash Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled chest is unstable if it is not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. The chest does not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM 2057-17). Units: About 200.

title: Safavieh Recalls Chests of Drawers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 760.

title: Browning Recalls Pistol Holsters Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The holster design can change the position of the safety switch on the firearm without the user knowing it. When this occurs, if the trigger is accidentally pulled, the firearm could fire unexpectedly, posing an injury hazard to the user and bystanders. Units: About 1,265.

title: Kolcraft Recalls Inclined Sleeper Accessory Included with Cuddle 'n Care and Preferred Position 2-in-1 Bassinets & Incline Sleepers to Prevent Risk of Suffocation
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported with other manufacturers' inclined sleep products, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side, or under other circumstances. Units: About 51,000.

title: Contigo Reannounces Recall of 5.7 Million Kids Water Bottles Due to Choking Hazard; Additional Incidents with Replacement Lids Provided in Previous Recall
summary: The water bottle's clear silicone spout can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 5.7 million (In addition, about 157,000 were sold in Canada and about 28,000 sold in Mexico) These water bottles were previously recalled in August 2019..
